financings_after_balance_sheet.what: February 2026 private placement of pre-funded warrants with accompanying common warrants
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: On February 17, 2026, we announced the closing of a private placement with net cash proceeds of approximately $187.0 million.

warrants.quote: warrants to purchase up to an aggregate of 283,334 shares of common stock, representing 5.0% of the shares sold in the April 2025 Offering (the “Placement Agent Warrants”).
